# Amazon Bedrock Agent Runtime

Execute only user-defined agent fixtures and store session checkpoints locally.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `bedrockagentruntime` |
| Signing name | `bedrock` |
| Wire protocol | REST JSON |

| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Local behavior |
| Selected operations | 14 of 35 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#amazon-bedrock-agent-runtime) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- No model inference, invented trace events, citations, knowledge-base retrieval, inline agents, flows, Retrieve, RetrieveAndGenerate, Rerank, GenerateQuery or OptimizePrompt. enableTrace emits no trace events.
- Runtime session tagging is unsupported: runtime TagResource/UntagResource/ListTagsForResource and CreateSession.tags are not whitelisted, avoiding shared-signing-name /tags route collisions with bedrockagent.
- Fixture steps define the complete action plan and final answer; Lambda results do not trigger model orchestration. Built-in UserInput/CodeInterpreter groups are stored only; fixture execution requires Lambda or RETURN_CONTROL.
- Standalone session KMS keys are validated but records use the configured TinyStack storage backend; no AWS KMS encryption or remote vector-store execution.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.

The table is generated from the profile and pinned Smithy model. Routes show REST bindings or the standard
JSON/Query endpoint. RPC v2 CBOR uses its service/operation route, as described in
[protocol handling](../architecture/request-flow.md). Supported members are selected separately in the
[shape whitelist](https://github.com/amjadjibon/tinystack/blob/main/generator/model/profile.json); an enabled operation may reject unsupported options.
